description: This file defines a class for rendering an asterisk marker in a graph, extending a base marker class, and includes methods for drawing the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Asterisk
classes.description: A class representing an asterisk-shaped marker for graph plotting, extending the base Image_Graph_Marker class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws an asterisk marker on the canvas at specified (x, y) position.
